lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high, except for the grid view pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.
Grid view pet companion redesign and clear re-authentication sign-in copy were helpful.
Adding new screens (validation stage or personality selection) performed worse.
Reordering onboarding flow to narrative-first performed worse, while deferring sign-in showed no clear effect.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, notifications, status banners, or wait info showed no clear effect.
Simplifying path choice layout showed no clear effect, while most other redesigns had no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Two Column Path Choice View
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a two-column layout contrasting quick companion selection directly against custom photo creation.
candidates.why: 23.8% dropoff on choose_path with a high mean time of 514s indicates decision confusion when choosing between setup paths.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-adopt companion or design a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesign retains both adoption and custom creation paths as required.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns for choose_path showed no clear historical effect.

candidates.title: Centered Account Authentication Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a clean centered layout emphasizing account synchronization and direct single-click login options.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 24.8% of users, and 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets due to re-authenticating under wrong accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Companion
sign_in.body: Connect your account so your pet profile and desktop data stay safely synced.

guard.reason: Sign-in layout redesign preserves the required account authentication function.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence, but layout redesigns carry risk.

candidates.title: Checklist Adoption Certificate Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a structured checklist layout confirming pet details and companion verification.
candidates.why: 26.9% dropoff during adoption and support reports regarding custom pet generation issues.

adoption_certificate.headline: Confirm Pet Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion details and confirm official registration.

guard.reason: Replacing the adoption certificate with a checklist removes the required official stamp display.

candidates.title: Split Waiting View Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout placing asset generation status side-by-side with desktop rendering status.
candidates.why: The home waiting stage has a 18.7% dropoff and an average wait time of 2336s, while users report pets failing to spawn.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival
waiting.body: We are generating and loading your pet companion files now.

guard.reason: Split waiting view maintains the job of showing that the pet is being created.

candidates.title: Card Layout Home Intro Overview
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a card layout highlighting essential controls to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: The finish step has the lowest conversion at 64.8%, and users wrote support emails expressing confusion on controlling or hiding the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Active
home_intro.body: Your companion is live on your desktop. Learn how to interact with it below.

guard.reason: Home intro redesign remains within onboarding scope and keeps core functionality.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff step, but redesigns on finish previously failed.

candidates.title: Direct Journey Selection Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update the story screen copy to clearly outline the difference between quick adoption and custom generation before choosing.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing users spend significant time trying to understand what each path requires.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt a pre-made pet in seconds or create a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Story screen copy update effectively introduces the companion options.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak; choose_path copy previously gained +3.0%.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to sync existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different or fresh account.

sign_in.hint: Use the same sign-in provider you used previously to restore existing pets.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful sign-in hint does not violate any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High support evidence, but sign-in hints previously lost conversion (-2.3%).

candidates.title: Upload Photo Clarity Guidelines Copy
candidates.change: Rewrite upload_photos text with explicit tips on lighting and angles to ensure accurate pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, causing abandonment during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit, front-facing photos of your pet for best custom 3D generation results.
upload_photos.hint: Avoid blurry pictures or extreme angles for optimal accuracy.

guard.reason: Copy updates on photo upload page provide helpful guidelines without changing pricing or data requests.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy clarification targeting adoption dropoff.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Stage Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Enable step counter and estimated time display on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: High mean waiting time (2336s) causes users to think the app stalled before the pet appears on the desktop.

guard.reason: Time estimate and step counter on waiting screen reflect a real wait period during asset generation.

candidates.score_note: Wait info previously yielded small positive gains (+2.2%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Copy
candidates.change: Update home_intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to right-click, move, or hide the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives emails from users unsure how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, chat, or temporarily hide it.

guard.reason: Home intro copy update accurately introduces desktop pet interaction controls.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest dropoff step with low-cost copy improvements.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high for unsuccessful tests, but underestimated the gains of winning tests.
Specific layout redesigns (grid view pet companion, centered sign-in, two-column path choice) were helpful, though other redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Adding new onboarding screens (such as quality validation or personality selection) consistently performed worse.
Reordering onboarding flow performed worse (narrative-first) or showed no clear effect (defer sign-in).
Most copy changes showed no clear effect, except for clear re-authentication sign-in copy which was helpful.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, wait info, notifications, or status banners showed no clear effect.
